rule.statement: A person of good repute and competent knowledge and ability who engages in conduct that changes their character and makes them no longer of good repute is liable to be subjected to disciplinary action.
rule.supporting_quote: It is the persons of “good repute and of competent knowledge and ability” who could be admitted as attorneys-at-law as provided under section 40(1) of the Judicature Act. Therefore, if a person of good repute after admission as an attorney-at-law engages in any conduct that changes the quality of his character and makes him no longer a person of good repute, such a person is liable to be subjected to disciplinary action as provided under the Judicature Act and the Rules of the Supreme Court.
